verses: Yaqeenan hum ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko unn ki qom ki taraf bheja kay apni qom ko dara do (aur khabardaar kerdo) uss say pehlay kay unn kay pass dard-naak azab aajaye
(Nooh alaihi as-salam ney) kaha aey meri qom! mein tumhen saaf saaf daraney wala hun
Kay tum Allah ki ibadat kero aur ussi say daro aur mera kaha mano
To woh tumharay gunah bakhsh dey ga aur tumhen aik waqt muqarrara tak chor dey ga. Yaqeenan Allah ka wada jab aajata hai to moakhir nahi hota. Kaash kay tumhen samajh hoti
(Nooh alaihi as-salam ney) kaha aey meray perwardigar!mein! mein ney apni qom ko raat din teri taraf bulaya hai
Magar meray bulanay say yeh log aur ziyadah bhagney lagay
Mein ney jab kabhi unhen teri bakhsish kay liye bulaya unhon ney apni ungliyan apney kanon mein daal len aur apney kapron ko orh liya aur arr gaye aur bara takabbur kiya
Phir mein ney unhen ba-aawaz buland bulaya
Aur be-shak mein unn say aelaaniya bhi kaha aur chupkay chupkay bhi
Aur mein ney kaha kay apney rab say apney gunah bakhshwao (aur moafi maango) woh yaqeenan bara bakhshney wala hai
Woh tum per aasman ko khoob barasta hua chor dey ga
Aur tumhen khoob pay darpay maal aur aulad mein taraqqi dey ga aur tumhen baghaat dey ga aur tumharay liye nehren nikal dey ga
Tumhen kiya hogaya hai kay tum Allah ki bartari ka aqeedah nahi rakhtay
Halankay uss ney tumhen tarah tarah say peda kiya hai
Kiya tum nahi dekhtay kay Allah Taalaa ney upper talay kiss tarah saat aasman peda ker diye hain
Aur unn mein chand ko jagmata banaya hai aur sooraj ko roshan chiragh banaya hai
Aur tum ko zamin say aik (khaas ehtimam say) ugaya hai (aur peda kiya hai)
Phir tumhen ussi mein lota ley jaye ga aur (aik khaas tareeqa) say phir nikalay ga
Aur tumharay liye zamin ko Allah Taalaa ney farash banadiya hai
Takay tum uss ki kushadah raahon mein chalo phiro
Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha aey meray perwerdigar! unn logon ney meri to na-farmani ki aur aison ki farmanbardari ki jin kay maal o aulad ney unn ko (yaqeenan) nuksan hi mein barhaya hai
Aur unn logon ney bara sakht fareb kiya
Aur kaha unhon ney kay hergiz apney maboodon ko na chorna aur na wad aur suwaa aur yaghoos aur yaooq aur nasar ko (chorna)
Aur unhon ney boht say logon ko gumrah kiya (elahi) to unn zalimon ki gumrahi aur barha
Yeh log ba sabab apney gunahon kay dobo diye gaye aur jahannum mein phoncha diye gaye aur Allah kay siwa apna koi madadgar unhon ney na paya
Aur (hazrat) Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay aey meray paalney walay! to aur zamin per kissi kafir ko rehney sehney wala na chor
Agar to unhen chor dey ga to (yaqeenan) yeh teray (aur) bandon ko (bhi) gumrah ker den gay aur yeh faajiron aur dheet kafiron hi ko janum den gay

Aey meray perwerdigar! to mujhay aur meray maa baap aur jo bhi eman ki halat mein meray ghar mein aaye aur tamam momin mardon aur aurton ko bakhsh dey aur kafiron ko siwaye barbadi kay aur kissi baat mein na barha
